definitions.matrix_cosine: Frobenius cosine of normalized full Hplus matrices; includes eigenvalue redistribution
definitions.subspace_overlap: ||U0.T UD||F^2/k, k fixed to D0 trace90 rank. Eigenvector signs and within-space basis rotations do not affect this metric.
definitions.top1: Absolute dot of largest-positive-eigenvalue directions; may be ambiguous at degeneracy
